title: Shared view links (ADR 0033)
description: Anyone with a link opens one frozen view the person chose, on the link's own host in the view namespace, while the link is valid. Only the person's app session creates, changes and revokes links; the administrator sees metadata and revokes any. App-origin messages: GET /api/v1/view-links (the person's links; an empty 204 when the operator has not enabled links, which means none are offered), POST /api/v1/view-links (create), POST /api/v1/view-links/change (one change: extend, re-point or a new address), POST /api/v1/view-links/revoke (204), GET /api/v1/server/view-links and POST /api/v1/server/view-links/revoke (administrator, 204).

title.description: The view's title when the link was created or re-pointed; agent text, shown as data.

link.description: One of the person's links. The URL is the key: anyone who has it opens the view until it expires or is revoked.

list.description: GET /api/v1/view-links: the person's valid links, newest first, and the operator's longest expiry in days.

createRequest.description: POST /api/v1/view-links: one of the person's views, valid for days (at most the operator's maximum). The gateway confirms through the person's daemon that the view exists.

changeRequest.description: POST /api/v1/view-links/change: exactly one change. days makes the link valid that many days from now; view_id points the same URL at another of the person's views; new_address replaces the token, so every copy of the old URL stops working.

revokeRequest.description: POST /api/v1/view-links/revoke or /api/v1/server/view-links/revoke: the link to remove. The next read of it fails.

adminList.description: GET /api/v1/server/view-links: every valid link's metadata for the administrator's abuse response, newest first. Never a URL or token. enabled says whether the operator currently serves links.

username.description: The owner's account name, as in the server administration list.
